charts.title: TOI-6038 A b: orbits around TOI-6038 A
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6038 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6038 A b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Baliwal et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169..147B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BALIWAL_ET_AL_2025): P 5.8267311 d

charts.title: TOI-6038 A b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6038 A b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (18, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 194736418, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 20-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
